definitions.quote: Academic misconduct occurs where a student gains, or attempts to gain, an unfair academic advantage.
This happens where a student incorporates the work of others (published or unpublished) in their own work without properly acknowledging it.
Any intentional or unintentional act of working with other students to produce work that is falsely represented as individual.
Poor scholarship is not academic misconduct. It refers to mistakes arising from a lack of academic skill or understanding.
Unintentional acts of academic misconduct occur when students fail to follow academic integrity guidelines due to a lack of understanding, rather than deliberate intent.
